description:
On outer-planet missions (Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto) viewed at /fly, the HUD speed readout shows 'NaN km/s' after the spacecraft passes ~2.5 AU heliocentric distance. The same bug affects Ceres, Vesta, Psyche, and Bennu missions at their respective thresholds.

Expected: The HUD speed readout shows a positive finite speed (km/s) at all heliocentric distances for every destination, computed from the correct Hohmann-transfer semi-major axis for the active destination.

Acceptance criteria:
- The transfer semi-major axis argument to flyHeliocentricSpeed (line 952) uses the active destination's orbit, not a hardcoded Earth-Mars average: isMoonMission ? R_EARTH_AU : (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a) / 2 [spec: fly-physics.ts doc comment: 'For an Earth→Mars Hohmann a ≈ 1.262' = (1+1.52366)/2, confirming the formula is (R_EARTH_AU + a_dest)/2]
- heliocentricKms is a finite positive number (not NaN, not Infinity, not negative) for every simDay value in [dep_day, arr_day] across all 12 DestinationId values (mercury, venus, mars, jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, pluto, ceres, vesta, psyche, bennu) [code-invariant: NaN from sqrt(negative) is undefined arithmetic; .toFixed(2) displays NaN, which is a display-level crash]
- The DESTINATIONS map is already imported and used elsewhere in +page.svelte (fly-scene-constants.ts, fly-helio-scene.ts, explore/+page.svelte) — no new imports needed [repo-data: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte line 65-66 imports DESTINATIONS; src/lib/fly-scene-constants.ts line 65 uses DESTINATIONS[destinationId].a; src/lib/three/fly-helio-scene.ts lines 567, 961 use DESTINATIONS[id].a]

Domain facts:
- Vis-viva equation: v = sqrt(µ · (2/r − 1/a)). The term (2/r − 1/a) must be positive for a real result. NaN occurs when r > 2a.
- Hohmann transfer semi-major axis from Earth (1 AU) to destination a_dest: a_transfer = (1 + a_dest) / 2
- Jupiter a = 5.20336 AU | Saturn a = 9.53707 AU | Uranus a = 19.19126 AU | Neptune a = 30.06896 AU | Pluto a = 39.482 AU | Ceres a = 2.766 AU | Vesta a = 2.3617 AU | Psyche a = 2.923 AU | Bennu a = 1.1264 AU (from planets.json and small-bodies.json)
- DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a is already available and imported in +page.svelte (line 65-66)

Target: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — line 952 — the aTransfer argument to flyHeliocentricSpeed
